HTTP 402-style payment gating for agents/servers. Open-source, on NPM. Relevant for monetizing agent APIs or micro-paywalls on wick.pics products. ⟲ Reassessed 2026-06-15: trial · mktg=low · FREE. HTTP-402-style on-chain micro-payment rails (now a real Stripe/Tempo/Visa standard with a Monad extension) for gating agent APIs and wick.pics products on a chain we already operate; worth a small trial for crypto-native monetization.

Open-source (github.com/midudev/autoskills), free. Complements our Superpowers / Everything Claude Code stack — could auto-provision stack-specific skills into our CLAUDE.md / skills setup. ⟲ Reassessed 2026-06-15: trial · mktg=none · FREE. Free `npx autoskills` that auto-detects a project's stack and writes matching skills into CLAUDE.md; low-effort complement to our Superpowers/ECC setup that's cheap to trial on one repo.

Runs 70B LLMs on a 4GB GPU via slow layer-by-layer disk loading; latency makes it impractical when free OpenRouter/NVIDIA endpoints already cover our needs.

Worth evaluating as a private comms layer for agents and operators. ⟲ Reassessed 2026-06-15: watch · mktg=none · FREE. Best-in-class private messenger with no user identifiers and self-hostable relays — genuinely strong for private operator/agent comms but not a current priority over our working Telegram pipeline, and irrelevant to the marketing push.

name: Shadowbroker
notes: Open-source multi-domain OSINT dashboard by BigBodyCobain. Aggregates 60+ live feeds (ADS-B flights, AIS ships, satellites, CCTV, seismic, GDELT, Shodan, etc.) into one map UI. Stack: Next.js 16 + FastAPI + Playwright + meshtastic. 7.5k stars, AGPL-3.0, actively maintained. Audit: clean (no postinstall hooks, no eval/exec abuse, no curl|bash, all outbound URLs match advertised data sources). Cloned to ~/projects/Shadowbroker, not installed. Default ports 3000/8000 conflict with next-server + Mem0; needs BACKEND_PORT override. Mandatory API keys: AIS_API_KEY (aisstream.io), OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET. Supports an AI agent co-analyst via HMAC-signed command channel. ⟲ Reassessed 2026-06-15: skip · mktg=none · FREE. OSINT aggregation dashboard already cloned and audited clean, but it needs paid API keys (AIS/OpenSky) to be useful and has no marketing or crypto-revenue tie-in — park it, don't deploy.

Think "llms.txt, but for auth." Worth adopting wherever agents authenticate; we are implementing it on onchain.wick.pics. ⟲ Reassessed 2026-06-15: adopt-now · mktg=none · FREE. Real, free, OAuth-based open standard from WorkOS (May 2026, Cloudflare/Firecrawl as early adopters) for AI-agent self-registration/payment — strategic agent-auth infra we already plan for onchain.wick.pics, so ship the auth.md file as a cheap first-mover credibility win.
